measurement_scope: predict_code() compute path only (direct in-process Python call, NO HTTP/network layer, NO IDE/editor round trip)
label: backend inference latency (NOT real-time IDE latency, NOT editor-to-annotation latency)
note_on_model_used: This measures the latency of the CURRENTLY DEPLOYED backend inference pipeline (predictor.py / the existing production XGBoost+SHAP+dataflow pipeline). This is a SYSTEMS/ENGINEERING measurement only. It provides NO evidence about detection accuracy -- accuracy is evaluated exclusively via the new CWE-89 corpus experiment (final_cwe89_experiment_v2/), which uses freshly-trained models on the new corpus, not this deployed pipeline.
